name: The Mystery of Bonertown
source:
The main character of this story is a simple guy from a small town.
At a certain point, his life is turned upside down when he meets a mysterious woman one evening.
The main character of this story will have to survive in this city, while preserving the love of his girlfriend…
translation:
本故事的男主角是一名来自小镇的普通青年。
某个夜晚与一位神秘女子的邂逅，让他原本平静的生活彻底天翻地覆。
他必须在这座危机四伏的城市里设法求生，同时守护好自己与女友之间的爱情……
